name: Triple Bubble Trouble
source:
Triple Bubble Trouble is an Adult Visual Novel game with story placed in real-life like world. You play as a male student Name-kun, who mysteriously lost his memories. Discover the world of drama, comedy, horror and romance with our heroines. Every girl has unique style, hobbies and personality, acting differently in every situation you come across.

[From [url=https://www.studio-vely.com/]Studio Vely[/url]]
translation:
Triple Bubble Trouble是一款成人视觉小说游戏，故事发生在现实世界中。你扮演一名神秘失去记忆的男学生Name-kun。与我们的女主角一起探索戏剧、喜剧、恐怖和浪漫的世界。每个女孩都有独特的风格、爱好和个性，在遇到的每种情况下都有不同的表现。

[来自[url=https://www.studio-vely.com/]Studio Vely[/url]]
